name: Pendulum Forest
description: A misty forest where enormous brass clock pendulums hang from ancient branches and swing above mossy ground.
prompt: A single mesmerizing scene of a misty forest where enormous brass clock pendulums hang from ancient tree branches, swinging gently above a mossy floor. Soft golden light filters through leaves, ferns and glowing mushrooms below, a narrow path winding between pendulums. Surreal time-themed fantasy, rich green and brass palette, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: In this forest, time doesn't fly—it swings. Would you walk beneath the pendulum trees?
